[[File:ENY-Digenis Ypsonas Logo.png|thumb|Old Logo used between 2014–2022]]

'''Krasava ENY Ypsonas''' is a [[Cyprus|Cypriot]] professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Ypsonas]] of the [[Limassol District]].

Founded in 2014 as ENY Digenis, the team was taken over by [[Yevgeny Savin]] in 2022, becoming Krasava ENY Ypsonas. In 2025 the team was promoted to [[Cypriot First Division]]."}}
